## Introduction

Hi, I'm Gregory M. Kapfhammer! I innovate in technical areas such as software
engineering and software testing, I teach [courses](/teaching/index.qmd),
conduct [research](/research/index.qmd), write
[papers](/research/papers/index.qmd) and a [blog](/blog/index.qmd), give
[presentations](/research/presentations/index.qmd), create
[software](/software/index.qmd), and [serve](/service/index.qmd) organizations.
Working as an Associate Professor in the [Department of Computer
Science](http://www.cs.allegheny.edu) at [Allegheny
College](http://www.allegheny.edu), I am an associate editor for the [Journal of
Software: Evolution and
Process](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/20477481), an academic editor
for the [PeerJ Computer Science](https://peerj.com/computer-science/) journal, a
program committee member for conferences like the [International Conference on
Software Testing, Verification and
Validation](https://cs.gmu.edu/icst/index.html) and the [International
Conference on Automated Software
Engineering](https://conf.researchr.org/series/ase), and a reviewer for journals
like [Transactions on Software
Engineering](https://www.computer.org/csdl/journal/ts). I am also the co-host of
the [Software Engineering Radio](https://www.se-radio.net/), the podcast for
professional software developers.
You can learn more about me
and my work by reading my [biography](/biography/index.qmd) and downloading my
[curriculum
vitae](https://github.com/gkapfham/curriculum-vitae/releases/download/v1.5.0/curriculum_vitae_kapfhammer.pdf).
